title: Tracked import resolution
responsibility: Resolves a scanned reference to a tracked repository file, external package or explicit uncertainty.

inputs.name: resolveHttpEndpoint.reference
inputs.description: Scanned source reference; absolute HTTP(S) or protocol-relative specifiers are returned as external, while leading-slash specifiers are matched against tracked endpoints. A null specifier yields non-literal uncertainty using detail or an empty string; output typeOnly is always false.

inputs.name: resolveHttpEndpoint.context
inputs.description: Read-only set of repository-relative tracked paths and the owning workspace root. Endpoint matching considers only tracked src/routes/**/+server.[cm]?[jt]s files beneath that root.

inputs.name: resolveImport.from
inputs.description: Repository-relative path of the importing source file. Relative and style imports resolve from its directory; $lib/ imports resolve from context.workspaceRoot/src/lib.

inputs.name: resolveImport.reference
inputs.description: Scanned source reference with a literal specifier or null, its resolution channel, type-only flag, and optional detail. A null specifier yields non-literal uncertainty; via http selects endpoint matching, whose result has typeOnly false.

inputs.name: resolveImport.context
inputs.description: Read-only set of repository-relative tracked paths and the owning workspace's repository-relative root. The resolver uses these paths to recognize tracked candidates and does not read files from disk.

outputs.name: resolveImport
outputs.description: Resolution result retaining the reference channel and, except for HTTP resolution, its type-only flag, with either a tracked repository-relative path, an external module name, or explicit uncertainty. File matching tries the configured suffixes and index files plus the .js-to-.ts fallback, without reading the filesystem.

outputs.name: resolveHttpEndpoint
outputs.description: Result for an HTTP source reference; it carries the reference channel, always sets typeOnly to false, and contains a tracked endpoint path, the original external specifier, or explicit uncertainty. It matches only tracked server files beneath the owning workspace and leaves missing or tied candidates unresolved.
